brief.Text: The field glasses are cracked. Disturbed Vortexoids northwest of here, around 1220 by 700, carry Primary and Secondary Infrared Filters. Bring both. {completequest XK08}

progress.Text: Primary and Secondary Infrared Filters, from the Disturbed Vortexoids northwest of this tent.

turnin.Text: The filters will sit. The glasses are repaired, and here is a Permafrost Battery. Carry the tubes and the battery to the melting tool when your Computer Literacy is ready. One Who Lights The Way stands at 1241 by 916. {take PK03}{take PK04}{completequest XK0A}

need_filters.Text: I still need a Primary Infrared Filter and a Secondary Infrared Filter.

after.Text: One Who Lights The Way is at 1241 by 916.
